description_for_human: Run guest-permissions scans, check status, query telemetry, and fetch Grafana endpoint.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to orchestrate the guest-permissions pipeline in Azure. Use startGuestPermissionsPipelineRun only when a run is explicitly requested or needed for fresh data. Use listGuestPermissionsPipelineExecutions to report execution health and status history. Use queryGuestPermissionsTelemetry for KQL-based guest IAM analysis. Use getGrafanaWorkspaceEndpoint when the user asks for dashboard access links. Use checkGuestEffectiveAccess whenever the user asks to verify a guest's real enforced access for specific actions, especially when a deny assignment might apply — telemetry only reports assigned roles, not live enforcement.

functions.name: getGrafanaWorkspaceEndpoint
functions.description: Get Grafana workspace endpoint metadata to build direct dashboard links.

functions.name: listGuestPermissionsPipelineExecutions
functions.description: List guest-permissions pipeline executions and statuses for run health reporting.

functions.name: queryGuestPermissionsTelemetry
functions.description: Run KQL against workspace telemetry to summarize Entra and Azure guest permissions.

functions.name: startGuestPermissionsPipelineRun
functions.description: Start a new guest-permissions pipeline run for fresh IAM telemetry.

confirmation.title: Start guest-permissions scan?
confirmation.body: This launches a new tenant scan and may run for several minutes. Continue?

functions.name: checkGuestEffectiveAccess
functions.description: Authoritatively check whether a specific guest is Allowed or Denied for specific control-plane or data-plane actions at a resource-group scope, using Azure's live Check Access decision engine (accounts for deny assignments and active RBAC role precedence). Use this whenever telemetry alone cannot resolve whether a deny assignment is actually being enforced.
